events.transcript: ALPHA, this is BRAVO. REQUEST. Alter your course to port to pass astern of me. I intend to maintain my present course. Over.
events.expected_response: Decline the unsafe port alteration, identify the conflict with CHARLIE, and continue an independently safe collision-avoidance response.
events.forbidden_outcome: Executing BRAVO's requested port alteration without independently establishing safe clearance from CHARLIE.
